title: Read-only PR request and trusted workflow-run dispatcher for generated-artifact refresh

phases.objective: Restore an observable exact-head path to the registered generated-artifact writer through a strictly read-only pull-request request artifact and a separately trusted workflow-run dispatcher, without candidate checkout, pull-request write authority, direct contents mutation, protected-branch mutation, or secrets.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted default-branch request workflow, trusted workflow-run dispatcher, and registered generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A synchronize event on an open ready-for-review same-repository PR targeting main and carrying the generated-artifact-refresh label, or an explicit exact-head manual request
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The pull-request stage emits a read-only exact-head request artifact; the independent workflow-run dispatcher downloads that exact run-bound artifact, revalidates the current PR, dispatches the registered writer with typed confirmation, observes the exact delegated run ID, and directly publishes canonical structured evidence.
steps: Run Governed Generated Artifact Refresh PR Target Request from protected default-branch workflow code on pull_request_target synchronize or explicit workflow_dispatch.
Ignore github-actions[bot] synchronization so a generated writer commit cannot recursively request another writer run.
Perform no repository checkout and grant only contents:read and pull-requests:read to the request workflow.

Read the current pull request through the GitHub API and require open non-draft state, same-repository head, base main, governed work-branch syntax, exact current head SHA, and generated-artifact-refresh label.
Trigger Governed Generated Artifact Refresh Request Dispatcher only from completion of the named request workflow or explicit workflow_dispatch.
Download the exact request artifact using the triggering workflow run ID and reject source-run substitution.
Re-read and revalidate PR state, repository identity, branch, label, and exact current head before checkout or API mutation.
Reject main and Production through an explicit target_branch guard that emits blocked evidence and exits non-zero.
Dispatch governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml on main with target_ref, expected_head_sha, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH.
Observe only the workflow_dispatch run whose exact display title contains the same target ref and SHA.
Checkout trusted main publisher code only after candidate validation, with persisted credentials disabled.
Upload and directly publish mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch.v1 before enforcing the result.

Run the focused bridge contract through this E2E journey; canonical test-manifest registration is intentionally deferred until the restored writer can update the dependent generated evidence in a follow-up governed change.
assertions: The pull-request request workflow has no actions:write, issues:write, contents:write, write-all, API mutation, checkout, git push, or secret access.
The pull-request request workflow emits structured evidence only and does not publish comments or dispatch workflows.
The write-capable dispatcher has workflow_run and workflow_dispatch entrypoints but no pull_request, pull_request_target, push, or issue_comment trigger.
The dispatcher has actions:write, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:read with no contents:write.
The dispatcher validates an exact run-bound request artifact and current PR identity before checkout or API mutation.
Only same-repository ready-for-review PRs targeting main and carrying the explicit refresh label may dispatch.
Forks, drafts, stale heads, substituted artifacts, invalid branches, main, and Production fail closed.
The dispatcher checks out trusted main only and never checks out the PR head, merge ref, or candidate SHA.
The writer remains the only workflow with repository contents-write authority.
Passed evidence requires delegated_run_observed=true and a numeric delegated_run_id.
The focused test is executed by E2E governance even though generated manifest registration is excluded from this bootstrap PR.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only; consult_job_logs=false and secrets_included=false.
No migration, SQL, deployment, Production mutation, provider call, credential access, external send, direct protected-branch update, or force push occurs in either bridge stage.

phases.objective: Observe one synchronization of PR #4742 produce an eligible request artifact, a canonical dispatcher decision, an exact delegated writer run ID, and a bounded generated commit.

Exercise fork, draft, stale head, source-run substitution, missing label, invalid branch, inactive writer, rejected dispatch, unobserved exact run, and bot-generated synchronization without candidate checkout or direct repository mutation.
This repository-control bridge performs no external provider or deployment canary.
The bridge rejects protected branches and grants no migration, deployment, runtime, provider, credential, or Production authority.
